tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

The Tenderer should be a single business entity and may either be a proprietorship Firm, or company, or partnership firm, or Limited Liability Partnership firm or Society which is registered under the relevant statutory law.
Group of single business entities (Consortium) is not allowed to participate in this tender process.

The Tenderer should have a Registered/Branch Office in Karnataka. If incorporated elsewhere, should have necessary permission/license to operate in Karnataka and the personnel proposed to be deployed for the services should be able to read write and speak in Kannada language.
The Tenderer should be in similar business of providing manpower services for at least 3 (three) financial years preceding the last date for submission of Tenders ie.2023-24, 2022-23, 2022-21

The Tenderer should hold a valid license issued by the competent authority under the Private Securities Agencies (Regulation) Act, 2005 and Karnataka Private Security Agencies Rules, 2008 (This is applicable in case of procurement of security man power services only)

The Tenderer should not be in default with respect to statutory payments such as contribution to ESIC, and contributions to EPFO and a declaration to this effect is required to be submitted by the Tenderer.
The Tenderer should provide the requisite number of manpower/personnel required for the services as specified in Appendix G

Tenderer must not be insolvent, in receivership, bankrupt are being wound up, not have its affairs administered by a Court or Judicial Officer, not have its business activities suspended and must not be the subject of legal proceeding for any of these reasons

In the event that two or more Tenderers quote the same amount of Service Fee (the Tie Tenderer), the Tenderer having the highest Technical Score shall be identified and declared as the Successful Tenderer. In the event the Technical Score of the Tie Tenderers happens to be same, the Tenderer having the highest Average Annual Turnover shall be identified and declared as the Successful Tenderer.
Submission of Nil Service Fee, Negative Fee/shall be rejected as nonresponsive

The Service Fee quoted by the Tenderer for providing the Manpower Services shall comprise the administrative costs and super vision charges of the Contractor which is inclusive of all applicable taxes viz., Income Tax, Turnover tax, profession tax, transportation, bonus if any and other overheads but exclusive of GST. The GST amount shall be paid separately by the Client as per the applicable rate
The Tenderer should follow Regarding outsourcing reservations law of attached document.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: No of Years of Experience: Tenderer should have been in the business of providing manpower services for at least (3(three)) financial years receding the last date for submission of Tenders. 1.At least 3 (three) years in the business of manpower services -15 marks 2.More than 3 years in the business of manpower services-5 marks for each additional 2years subject to the maximum of 10 (Additional) marks (i.e. FinancialYear 2024-25, 2023-24, 2022-23) -25 marks

Total number of Manpower deployed for any Central/State Govt./Semi Govt Preceding 3 years from the last date for submission of Tenders should have successfully deployed manpower for any Central/State Govt./Semi Govt such that the total/combined man power deployed are not less than (80% of the personnel required i.e 374 Number of personnel/year) 1.Deployed at least (80%) persons/users-15 marks. 2. Deployed more than (80%) persons/users -5 marks each such additional persons/users subject to the maximum of 10 (additional) marks (i.e. Financial Year 2024-25, 2023-24, 2022-23) -25 marks

Total number of Manpower deployed for any reputed Company: Preceding 3 years from the last date for submission of Tenders should have successfully deployed manpower for any reputed company established under the Companies Act, 1956 or 2013 such that the total/combined man power deployed are not less than (80% of the personnel required i.e 374 Number of personnel/year) 1. Deployed at least (80%) persons/users-5 marks. 2. Deployed more than (80%) persons/users-2.5 marks each such additional (10%) persons/users subject to the maximum of 5(Additional) marks (i.e. Financial Year 2024-25, 2023-24, 2022-23) -10 marks

Total Annual Turnover in the Business of Manpower Services: The Tenderer should have minimum Average Annual Turnover of Rs.196.84 Lakhs (Two times the amount put to tender Rs. 98.42 lakhs) from the last three completed financial Years preceding the last date for submission of Tenders (i.e. Financial Year 2024-25, 2023-24, 2022-23) 1. at least Average Annual Turnover of Rs. 196.84 lakhs (Not less than twice the amount put to tender Rs. 98.42 lakhs)-10 marks. 2. More than Average Annual Turnover of Rs. 196.84 lakhs (Not less than twice the amount put to tender Rs. 98.42 lakhs)-5 marks each additional Annual Turnover of thrice the amount put to tender of subject to the maximum of 10 (additional ) marks-20 marks

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Total Credit Facility: Tenderer should have credit facility of not less than Rs. 24.60 Lakhs (estimated cash flow for three months.) of credit line or letters of credit from the banks meeting the fund requirement 1. Have received at least Rs. 24.60 Lakhs (cash flow) payment for three months-10 marks. 2. Have received more than Rs. 24.60 Lakhs (months required cash flow as cash flow payment for three months) -5 marks for each additional (cash flow) payment of Rs received for three months subject to the maximum of 10 (Additional) marks-20 marks
